comment: SP-5c Phase 2 d_h block-routed capture (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-02-sp5c-phase2-dh-capture.md Sec.0). Copy of sp5_skew_r3b_pc's geometry with Event_Broadcast_Block masks (0xC000 on mem-mod East / core-mod West per AIE compute tile, switch-A East/West per memtile, cols 0-2 rows 1-5) applied before both floods, forcing shim-row-only horizontal routing + per-column climb -- the real timer-reset broadcast path. s1 flood on broadcast ch15 (BROADCAST_15=122), s2 on ch14 (BROADCAST_14=121). Perf-counter arms START=122 STOP=121. Under this routing the model reduces to r_X = const + dn_h*d_h (vertical terms cancel exactly) -- this capture is d_h-ONLY; d_v is rank-deficient here by construction (Phase-0 guard test_block_routed_capture_is_rank_deficient_for_dh_dv), not a defect. Horizontal spine (0,3)/(1,3)/(2,3) carries all the d_h leverage (dn_h = [2,0,-2]); the vertical-spine tiles (1,2)/(1,4)/(1,5) are dn_h=0 (redundant with (1,3)) and are kept only as ballast/consistency with the free-flood kernel's counter_index layout -- they contribute no d_h information here. Virtual frame: rows 0 shim / 1 memtile / 2-5 core.
